Commentary.Commentary: The total is not a big one but the pitch is a difficult one. However, Australia should chase this down but if the Windies bowlers manage to hit their lengths right from the word go, we can well be in for a good second half. Wickets is what they need and it will be interesting to see if they do get it early. Stay tuned for the second essay.

The Aussies bowlers were on point. It was a combined effort from them. All the 5 who bowled got a wicket at least to his name. Carey too was excellent, he got the field placement right and also the changes. Starc was probably the pick with a three-fer but you can't just pick one, every bowler played their part.

End of a poor batting display by the hosts! The decision to actually bat first has not been the good one. They though got off to a decent start but it all went downward for them after Lewis went back retired hurt. They kept losing wickets and at one stage were reeling at 75 for 6. Lewis though, who resumed his innings, along with the lower-order has done well to give his sides' total some respectability.

OUT! GOT HIM! Starc gets his third and the final wicket! Comes over the wicket and bowls a pacy full toss angling around off. Cottrell is too early for his push and the ball hits the stump. The off pole goes cart-wheeling behind. West Indies end at 152.

SIX! Fifty for Evin Lewis! He has fought a lone battle for the Windies side! Really good knock! Started well, then went off after being hit on the helmet, came back and has continued in the same manner as he began. Well-deserved half ton and he gets a gift to get to that milestone. A full toss on middle, it is heaved over the long on fence for a biggie. 150 is also up for the hosts.
Around off, punched to covers.
LEG BYE! Spills it down the leg side. Cottrell steps across to flick but misses and takes a leg bye off the pads towards the fine leg.
Flatter on middle. Cottrell swivels across and blocks it.
Very full again on middle. Cottrell flicks it to square leg.
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Cottrell tucks it to mid-wicket.
A full toss on middle. Lewis pushes it back to the bowler who half-stops it but the batters are against a single.
Two runs now! Full and outside off. Lewis drives it through covers for a couple.
Another dot! Full ball on middle. Lewis drills it to long off but does not rotate the strike.
Misses his length and bowls a full toss. Lewis pushes it to covers.
Yorker length on middle. Lewis squeezes it out in time.
Around off, on a length. Lewis punches it to covers.
And Sheldon Cottrell survives the over! Full and outside off. Cottrell misses his push.
Another flatter and quicker on middle. Cottrell defends it out.
Around off. Cottrell manages to get his bat on it.
BEATEN! A googly on middle. Cottrell goes for the big heave but misses it, the ball misses the leg stump by a whisker.
Another flatter ball outside off. This is pushed on the off side.
Flatter and outside off. Cottrell pushes on the off side.
Bowls a perfect yorker on middle. Lewis gets his bat down in time.
On a length outside off. Lewis drives it uppishly but just short of mid off.
Beautiful yorker on middle. Lewis digs it out on the leg side.
SIX! Lewis will go for it now! A shorter ball on middle. Lewis gets on top of the bounce and pulls it al the way over square leg for a biggie.
Appeal but turned down! A full ball angling on middle and leg. Lewis misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. They appeal for LBW but not given. Sliding down.
A short ball on middle. Lewis looks to pull but gets a top edge, in the air and in the vacant mid-wicket region. He does not take a run.
Yes he does, almost. A full ball, it lands and spins in, outside off. Cottrell looks to push but manages an inside edge on the pads.
Sheldon Cottrell is the last man in. Can he survive one ball of this over?

OUT! STUMPED! Another one departs and the Windies are 9 down now! A full ball, a googly that lands on off and spins away. Hosein takes a big stride forward to push it but misses it. The ball sneaks through and the keeper collects it. He clips the bails off. Hosein had his feet in the air and that is superb work from Carey behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: st Alex Carey b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Stumping appeal and it is taken upstairs! Australia are very confident. The foot is in the air, NOT OUT is what flashed first on the big screen. Probably the wrong button was pressed but then it was changed to OUT!
On the pads again, this is tucked on the leg side for one more.
On the pads. Hosein stays low and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Very full on middle. This is pushed to covers.
Full toss outside off. Hosein pushes it to mid off.
Powerplay 3 signaled! Now 5 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the end of the innings. Also, Adam Zampa is back.
Single to end the over! On the pads, this is flicked to square leg for one.
Around off, on a length. Hosein blocks it out on the ground.
Way outside off. Left alone to the keeper.
Just short! A short of a length ball on off, getting big on Hosein who looks to defend but ends up slicing it just short of first slip who dives forward.
Another length ball on off. Hosein comes across to block it out.
Good length ball on off. Hosein taps it on the off side.
Akeal Hosein is off the mark! On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Length and on off, Hosein blocks it out.
A good short one, Akeal gets on top of the bounce nicely and plays it onto the ground.
Shorter and on the pads, Lewis looks to pull but misses, it hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Akeal Hosein is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Walsh goes now and Starc has another! Once again a change in bowler has got a wicket. This is a poor shot from Walsh. Not sure what he was trying to do. It is on a length and around middle, Walsh looks to go big over mid off. Ends up hitting it high up in the air and the fielder there takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Moises Henriques b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Lands safe! Shorter and on the body, Walsh looks to defend but this goes off the splice. It lands safe on the leg side.
Back of a length and on off, Lewis hangs back and defends it onto the ground.
A little too high! Just behind a length and on middle, it angles in, Lewis looks to defend but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Really good running! On off, this is pushed to mid off for a quick run.
FOUR! Flayed away! Full and wide outside off. Walsh throws his bat at it, he gets good connection and it goes through cover-point for a boundary. This should make Walsh feel really good.
Well left! Outside off, Walsh watches it go to the keeper.
BEATEN! Relentless stuff from Josh! Lands it on off and gets it to straighten. Walsh is beaten as he tries to block.
Lovely! Nice and slow, lands it on middle, Lewis defends it. Not a bad over for the Windies. 6 from it.
Quicker and on off, Lewis pushes it to covers.
Turner gives it a little more air this time, lands it on middle, defended.

FOUR! Really nicely played! The idea was good and the executition was even better! On the pads, Lewis sweeps, he gets on top of the bounce nicely and plays it all along the ground through square leg for a welcome boundary.
Floats it up on off, Walsh pushes it down to long off for one.
Misfield and one! Tossed up and on off, Lewis pushes it towards cover, the fielder runs to his left, slides but does not stop it. A run taken.
Ashton Turner is back into the attack.
Another one on a length and around off, Walsh pushes it to covers. A successful over from Josh on his return.
Not a clever shot! Walsh looks to drive this on the up, it is outside off. Walsh is beaten.
BEATEN! Length again and just outside off. Walsh hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
A shorter one on the body, Lewis pulls it down towards fine leg for one.
Walsh is off the mark! Back of a length and on middle, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Hayden Walsh walks out to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Josh Hazlewood is back on and he strikes! This is what he does so well, just keeps hitting that length around off which most of the times, gives him a wicket. It is on off, Joseph looks to defend but does so inside the line. It goes off the outisde edge and the keeper does the rest. Joseph played well but he needed to go on.
Commentary.Howout: c Alex Carey b Josh Hazlewood

Commentary.Commentary: Appeal but turned down! A flatter ball spinning in, around middle and leg. Lewis looks to defend but misses it completely. Ashton Agar finishes on 10-1-31-2.
Loopy ball on off. Lewis eases it to covers.
Full and on middle. Lewis blocks it on the deck.
Outside off. Lewis cuts it to point.
This one lands on off and spins away. Lewis gets hit on the pads as he looks to defend.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.
A leave to end! Outside off, left alone.
Another single! A low full toss on the pads, this is whipped down to long on for one more.
Flatter and on off, this one holds its line, Lewis hangs back and blocks it.
A low full toss, this is driven crisply, down towards mid off who runs to his right, slides and keeps it down to one.
Solid from Joseph! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Again a single from the first! On the pads, Lewis tucks it around on the leg side for one.
Flatter, quicker on middle. Joseph drills it to mid on.
Around off, Joseph looks to defend but does it with outer half of his bat towards point.
Full and on middle. Clipped to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off. Joseph defends it to the off side.
On middle. Joseph blocks it out.
Flatter on middle, Lewis flicks it to deep square leg for one run.

DRINKS!! The Windies have done well in the last 30 minutes or so, it is still Australia who are on top at the moment but the hosts are trying to get to a good score. Joseph and Lewis are amidst a good stand but they need to keep going, atl east for another 8 to 10 overs. Australia know they will have to make quick work of the remaining wickets as chasing anything over 200 is not going to be easy. An important passage awaits.
Another dot to end! Flatter and on off, Alzzari defends it onto the ground.
Floats it up on off, Joseph gently pushes it to mid off.
On the stumps, defended.
Flatter and on off, Joseph pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Dragged and in the gap! This is tossed up nicely and on off, Joseph plays it wide of the mid-wicket fielder in the deep for a boundary. This is a really good innings so far from Joseph.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
BEATEN! A good nut to end! The googly, it lands on off and then spins away. Lewis looks to defend but is beaten.
FOUR! Placed nicely and a welcome boundary! Shorter and outside off, Lewis plays it late and through point. The fielder in the deep, runs to his right, slides but his effort goes in vain.
A full toss, this is hit down to long on for one.
On middle, blocked.
That has missed everything! This is tossed up, it lands on middle and then spins away. Joseph looks to defend but is beaten. It flicks the back pad and goes into the gloves of the keeper. Going over.
On the pads, this is worked down to long on for one.
Flatter and on middle. Joseph works it to covers.
JUST OVER! Gives some flight to this, Tosses it up on off. Joseph drives it uppishly just over the cover fielder for a couple.
Loopy ball outside off. Kept out.
Tossed up ball on middle. Joseph blocks it out on the off side.
Around off, pushed to covers.
WIDE! Spills it down the leg side. Joseph lets it through. Wide given.
Flatter on middle. Lewis flicks off the back foot to the leg side for one.
Full and around off. Joseph defends it out.
Around off. Blocked out.
SIX! Much needed! Floated ball on off. Joseph stays back and powers it over long on for a biggie.
Darted on the pads. Joseph flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket who collects on a bounce.
WIDE! Full and way down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Review time! A huge appeal for an LBW has been turned down! If no bat, looks close.

NOT OUT! A flatter and quicker ball angling on middle and leg. Joseph rocks back to flick it but seems to get a big inside edge. Australia appeal for LBW but not given. They take the review. Ultra Edge shows a big deflection on the pads. So, Australia lose their second review.
Shorter and outside off. Lewis punches off the back foot to long off for a single.
Change of ends for Zampa!
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
Another way outside off delivery. Joseph lets it through.
Tossed up on off. Pushed to mid off.
Way outside off. Left alone.
Touch shorter and on middle. Joseph rocks back and blocks it.
Another full ball on middle. Lewis drives it through covers for one.
Serves a very full ball on middle. Lewis pushes it to covers.
Ashton Turner is back into the attack.
Angles a fuller ball outside off. Joseph solidly blocks it out.
Outside off. Joseph pushes it to covers.
EDGY RUNS! Another good length ball outside off. Lewis hangs his bat out and manages a thick outside edge towards third man for one.
On middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side. Lewis misses his pull, Wide given.
FOUR! Well played! A length ball outside off. Lewis rocks back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
SIX! He needs to keep hitting big ones! Full and outside off. Lewis leans into it and powers it over long off fence for a biggie.
Very full and on middle. Joseph pushes it to mid off.
Loopy ball on middle. Blocks it out.
Touch fuller outside off. Joseph pushes it to covers.
Around off, driven to covers for a quick single.
Good delivery! Flatter ball on middle, it rises off the deck and hits high on the blade off Lewis as he looks to defend it.
Full on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for one more.
WIDE! Short ball on middle. Lewis ducks under it. Wide signaled for height.
Angles in a full ball on middle. Joseph stays back and flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off. Pushed on the off side.
Length ball on middle. Joseph flicks it to square leg.
Angles this one with a pacy short of a length ball outside off. Joseph misses his push.
On middle. Lewis flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
A googly, around off. Alzarri Joseph is squared up as he looks to defend. A wicket-maiden over for Adam Zampa.

Alzarri Joseph is the new man in. Also, we did ask you if it was going to be the Hales show and guess what? IT WAS! Well, it was not exactly the Hales type of innings we are accustomed to but surely one he will cherish as he took his side over the line in a complete humdinger of a game.

OUT! BOWLED! Another one bites the dust and the Windies are in dire straits now! Zampa tosses it up, with an angle on middle and leg, it lands and spins in. It seemed like the googly. Holder is too early looks to go downtown but seems early in the shot, it goes under his bat and clips the leg pole. The pressure of dots just got to Holder. He tried to break the shackles but falls in the process.
On middle. Holder works it on the leg side.
Googly now, tosses it up on middle. Holder blocks it off the back foot
Full and on off. Holder pushes it to covers.
Flatter and quicker on middle. Holder looks to defend but gets an inside edge to the square leg.
Another back of a length delivery to end! Defended to cover. A good comeback by Starc, just what his skipper needed.
On a length and just outside off, left alone.
Extra bounce again! On middle, this one takes off after landing. Lewis does well to take one hand off the handle and work it on the leg side.
FOUR! Tickled away fine! On the body, Lewis works it fine and this one races away to the fence.
A short ball around off. Left alone.
Evin Lewis walks out to bat after leaving the field due to concussion.

OUT! CAUGHT! There is the big wicket Australia wanted! The Windies skipper walks back and he falls to Starc yet again. Really good change by Carey. We did feel this could be a good move and it does turn out to be a brilliant one. This is full and it is a cross-seam delivery which can be very effective on this surface and it is here. Pollard looks to drive but his mistake was he looked to drive on the up which is not a good idea on a wicket which is holding. It does stick in the surface, Pollard is through the shot, it goes uppishly to covers. Windies have half the side back in the hut now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ashton Turner b Mitchell Starc

Commentary.Commentary: Starc is back! This could well be a good decision by Carey!
Full on middle. Pollard pushes it to long on for one.
Darted on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket.
On middle. Pollard misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball lobs to the first slip.

FOUR BYES! BEAUTY! Tosses it up, on middle, googly as well. Pollard prods forward to defend but the ball sneaks through the bat and the pad, over the stumps. The keeper fumbles to carry it and it races away to the fine leg fence. The fielder in the deep dives and flicks it back but touches his shoulder to the ropes in the process.
Around off. Pollard pushes it to covers.
Flatter ball, skidding on the pads. This is clipped to square leg.
Another dot as this is pushed to covers.
Tosses it up on off. Holder pushes it to covers.
Now a flatter and quicker ball on middle. Blocked out.
Tossed up around off. Holder defends it to covers.
On middle. Holder lunges forward to defend it out.
FOUR! Sees a short ball and capitalizes on it. On middle. Holder pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Floats it on off. Holder pushes it to long off for a single.
Full on off. Holder defends it outl
Catch is the call but lands safely! loopy ball outside off. Pollard heaves it not quite of the middle of the bat, towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Around off, Pollard drills it to mid off.
Flatter ball around off. Pollard looks to push but gets an insde egde  onto the pads.
Tosses it up outside off. Pollard pushes it to covers.
Slower through the air now and outside off, left alone.
Darts it on middle, Holder goes back and works it to mid-wicket.
This time he plays it better as he wrists it through square leg for one.
Flatter and on middle, he does not want to be very full to Pollard! KP works it on the leg side.
Who will walk out now? It is going to be Jason Holder.

OUT! TAKEN! Bravo now departs! Agar gets his second. Really not sure if this was the right shot at the moment. Maybe his eyes just lit up with the ball being tossed up. It lands just outside off. Bravo looks to go over long on with the turn but the ball holds in the surface. He is through the shot and hence, it goes more off the outer half high up in the air towards cover-point where Josh Philippe takes an easy catch. Windies slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Josh Philippe b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Tosses it up on off, Bravo defends it.
Good first over by Zampa! The googly, to end, it is tossed up on off, defended.
Very full, almost a yorker, it is jammed back to the bowler.
On middle, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Edgy runs! Tosses it up on off, Bravo looks to push at it, he does so with soft hands. It is the googly, it goes off the outside edge and down to third man for two.
That is another beauty! The googly, lands on off, spins away and also zips through. Bravo is beaten as he tries to block.
Good start! The slider, it lands on off and then goes on with the angle. Beats the outside edge of the bat as Bravo tries to defend.
Adam Zampa is brought into the attack.
Flatter and on middle. This time Pollard prods forward to defend it out.
SIX! POWERED! Pitches it up, in the arc, on middle. Pollard stands tall and lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Darted on the pads, this is flicked away to deep square leg for two runs. Kieron Pollard is off the mark.
Very full and on middle. Bravo eases it to long on for a single.
Again Bravo flicks this one to mid-wicket.
Flatter on middle. Bravo clips it to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! All Australia so far! However, it was Windies who started off decently but after Lewis walked off the field, they have lost three wickets in no time and the runs aren't coming too. They need the two out there to form a stand. Also, the good news for them is Lewis has passed all the concussion test and is available to bat but will still be under observation. Australia on the other hand, will want to keep taking wickets as batting second will be even tougher.
A maiden then by Turner! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped hard to covers.
Flatter and on middle, Pollard pushes it back to the bowler.
Another leading edge! Once again Pollard looks to work it on the leg side but closes the face of the bat early, he gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Pollard looks to push at it but is beaten.
On the pads, Pollard looks to flick but is early to close the face, it goes off the leading edge all along the ground to covers.
Floats it up on middle, Pollard blocks it.
Full and on middle. Bravo pushes it with the angle to mid on.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side. Bravo misses his flick. Wide signaled.
Flatter and around off. Bravo lunges forward to block it out.
Full ball on middle. This is clipped to mid-wicket.
Shorter ball and angling on middle. Bravo defends this one on the leg side.
Tossed up again, around off. Bravo pushes it to the off side.
Appeal for LBW but not given! A tossed up ball angling on middle and off. Bravo strides forward to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Kieron Pollard walks out to bat.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a complete error in judgment by Pooran! A brain-fade one can say. Really not sure what he was doing there. This is tossed up nicely, it does drift back in from outside off. Lands just outside off and instead of turning away, goes on with the angle. Pooran probably felt it would turn away, puts in a big stride forward and lets it go. This one though hits the off stump as there is no turn. The hero of the last game walks back quickly. Windies in big trouble.
Really full again and on off, Pooran pushes it to covers.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On the pads, this is swept through square leg for one.
Two is the call but only a run! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Very full and on the pads, Bravo looks to flick but it goes off a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
On middle, Pooran goes back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter and on the pads, Pooran looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Just over! Down the leg side, Pooran looks to sweep, this goes off the glove as there is extra bounce. Over leg slip and towards fine leg for two. Pooran is off the mark.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Nicholas Pooran walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a superb catch from Marsh! This really took off after landing! It is on off, behind a driving length. Hope looks to push at it but this spins off the surface, it hits the splice and lobs towards point. Marsh there dives to his left and takes a good low catch. All of a sudden, the Windies are in a spot of bother here.
Commentary.Howout: c Mitchell Marsh b Ashton Agar

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on middle, Hope pushes it to covers.
Another one on off, it is kept out nicely.
On middle, defended.
Angled into the pads, Bravo works it fine on the leg side for two.
Slightly shorter and on off, Bravo pushes it to covers.
Flatter and on off, kept out.
Well bowled! Lands this on off, gets it to turn away. Bravo's outside edge is beaten as he tries to defend.
Quicker and on off, Hope plays it nice and late under his eyes. A good over from Agar.
Flatter now and on middle, this is worked with the angle to mid-wicket.
That is a beauty! Slows it up and lands it on off, this lands and then spins away! Goes past the outside edge of the bat as Hope tries to block.
Another single! On middle, this is worked to long on for one more.
Floats it up on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Flatter and on mddle, this is worked to square leg.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a total of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Another full ball outside off. Hope drags it across, towards mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Good delivery! A touch fuller ball, jags away. outside off. Hope looks to push but misses it.
On the pads. This is flicked to square leg for a single.
Another full ball outside off. Hope chops it wide of first slip who does well to dive to his right and save it. Single taken.
Full ball, angling in, on middle. Hope blocks it on the off side.
On a length and on middle. Bravo clips it to square leg for another single.
Flatter and on middle. Bravo flicks it to square leg for a single.
On middle, tucked away again to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on middle. Bravo flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Full ball and way outside off. Left alone to the keeper. Wide given.
SIX! Beautiful shot! A loopy ball outside off. Bravo lunges forward and hammers it over long on for the first maximum of the innings.

Well, if this slow approach from the Windies is something you are not enjoying, you can switch tabs and catch all the action from the 100. The home side there is chasing just over 130 and have lost Short, Root and Malan. Is it going to be the Hales show?
Darted on the pads. Bravo flicks it to short leg on a bounce.
Full and around off. Hope pushes it to long off for a single.
Full and way outside off. Bravo takes a big stride forward and lets it through. End of a wicke-taking over from Josh!
A good pacy short ball angling on middle and leg. Bravo sits under it.
On a length and on off. Bravo pushes it to the off side.
A good length ball, just around off. Left alone.
Darren Bravo walks out to bat!

OUT! Josh Hazlewood strikes and gets the first breakthrough! A good length ball outside off, the ball bounces a bit extra. Shimron Hetmyer hops and looks to push at it but gets an inside edge and it hits the stumps behind. Hetmyer is gutted with himself. He could have so easily left that. He went after it, played it away from his body and pays the price. Hazlewood is rewarded for his excellent bowling so far.
Good length ball around off. Hope works it to left of mid on who does well to dive and save some runs for his team. Single taken.
Single to end the over! Flatter ball around middle and leg. Hope flicks off the back foot to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Hope punches it to covers.
Full on middle. Hope eases it to mid on.
Flatter and outside off. Hope chops it to covers again.
Angles it on middle. Hope pushes it to covers.
Full and on the pads. This is clipped to square leg for one.
Ashton Agar is on now!
BEATEN! A good length ball outside off. Hope prods forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge to the keeper.
Another short ball outside off. Hetmyer dabs it to third man for a single.
A short of a length ball outside off, it shoots off the deck. Hetmyer was looking to cut it away but ends by dropping his hands. Good leave.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a fuller ball outside off. Hetmyer blocks it out on the off side.
On a length outside off. Punched to covers now.
Serves a full ball on middle. Hetmyer works it to mid on.
Short ball to end the over as Hope ducks under it.
On the pads, flicked away off the pads to the fine leg for one.
FOUR! Boundary to get off the mark! A full ball outside off. Hetmyer creams his drive through covers for a boundary.
Full and on middle. Shimron Hetmyer pushes it to mid on.
A back of a length ball outside off. Hope smacks it back to the bowler. Starch gets a hand on it and deflects it towards mid off. Single taken.
Full and way outside off. Hope drives it firmly but straight to point.
The physio is out to have a look! Lewis is seen leaving the field. Not a good sight but it is probably precaustionary. Shimron Hetmyer walks out to bat.
Ouchh, that might hurt! A short of a length ball angling on middle. Lewis looks to pull but gets a leading edge and gets hit straight on the helmet.
Around off. Lewis hops and blocks it out.
Goes fuller now, on off. Lewis pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A length ball outside off. Lewis slaps it through point for a boundary.

NOT OUT! That is off the trouser! A short of a length ball, way down the leg side. Lewis goes for the pull but misses it. Carey behind the sticks takes the catch and appeal for it straightaway as he thinks there was some bat. The umpire is unmoved. Australia go for the review and the Ultra Edge shows the sound was of the ball kissing the hips. Australia lose their review.
Review time! A huge appeal and the finger is not raised. Australia review. It is for a caught behind.
Fuller ball on middle. Lewis steps across and blocks it out.
Another way outside off delivery. Hope doesn't offer any stroke to it.
Full ball, angling across, outside off. Hope leaves it alone.
A full ball outside off. Hope drives it through covers for a couple of runs now.
Goes fuller now, on middle. Hope works it to mid on.
Beautiful stroke! A short of a length ball on off. Lewis punches off the back foot, past point for a single. He is off the mark.
A good length ball outside off. Lewis prods forward and leaves it alone.
So, maiden to start for Josh Hazlewood. A good length ball on off. Hope punches it to the off side.
Touch fuller this time, around off. Hope blocks it out to covers.
Another good length ball outside off. Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Nicely driven! A full ball outside off. Hope gets low to drive but finds the fielder at point.
On a length, in the channel, around off. Hope taps it to point.
A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Hope shoulders arms to it.
Josh Hazlewood to bowl with the second new ball.
Angles it on the pads. Lewis tucks it to mid-wicket. 7 runs coming in the first over.
Around off, on a length. Lewis blocks it to covers.
A touch fuller around off. Hope pushes it through mid off. The fielder chases it down near the ropes. Three taken.
Drags his length back a bit, outside off. Hope pushes it to covers.
Shai Hope is off the mark straightaway! A full ball, slanting across, around off. Hope pushes it to long off for a couple of runs.
LEG BYE! Another full delivery, angling down. Evin Lewis misses his flick and takes a leg bye off the pads towards the fine leg.
WIDE! Starts with a wayward delivery way down the leg side. Left alone. Wided. West Indies are off the mark.

We are all set for the action to begin! The Australian players make their way out to the middle. Now, the Windies openers, Shai Hope and Evin Lewis also stride out. Mitchell Starc has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
Alex Carey says that it is a series final and we are excited. Says that the T20s didn't go very well but they are looking forward to this game. Informs they have quite a few changes.

Kieron Pollard says that the sun is out and also because of the nature of the wicket he wants to bat first. Informs the change that Jason Mohamood is out. Says that they all have roles and responsibilities and if he needs to bowl for the team he is ready. Says that playing cricket is an opportunity, we will come out and win and all achievements will come with it.

So the Windies have just the one change! Jason Mohammed makes way for Hetmyer! Australia do have a few changes, Hazlewood comes back in for Meredith! Agar too makes way for his brother Ashton which means Australia are going in with two spinners and two pacers. Christian finds a place in the side too. So he with Marsh will probably bowl the quota of 10.
Australia (PLAYING XI) - Moises Henriques, Josh Philippe, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (C) (WK), Ashton Turner, Matthew Wade, Dan Christian, Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
West Indies (PLAYING XI) - Evin Lewis, Shai Hope (WK), Shimron Hetmyer, Darren Bravo, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard (C), Jason Holder, Alzarri Joseph, Hayden Walsh, Akeal Hosein, Sheldon Cottrell.

TOSS - West Indies have won the toss and have ELECTED TO BAT! Quite strange to be honest! They won the last game chasing but batting first is a lot easier than batting second. Interesting to see if it does work for them.

With all the T20I action and 100 ball action going on, we now turn our attention to the longest white ball format which is the 50-over game and a game of high importance. The winner takes it all! It is the decider, the third ODI between Australia and the Windies. After being battered in the first game, the Windies returned the favor as they leveled the series in style. Can they put in another similar performance or are we going to see the Aussies take away this series? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.
